speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Subacute Combined Degeneration of the Spinal Cord (likely due to Vitamin B12 deficiency).

The combination of rapid onset gait ataxia, lower extremity weakness, and cognitive/psychiatric changes (forgetfulness, paranoia) in a middle-aged male is highly suggestive of this condition. I need to confirm your nutritional history and check for other neurological signs before finalizing the diagnosis.
